title: Microsoft 365 admin center: target organizational messages with Action Segments
summary: Hold: the route to Usage targeting skips wizard choices that determine which audiences are available. The default is also described as unknown even though Learn documents an available, author-selected audience option that does not require enabling advanced targeting. The roadmap details, segment definitions, licensing and role-assignment controls are supported.
